aa.rule: two-sided t(1-0.05/(2*8), df) intervals for 8 phases must lie within [1/1.05, 1.05]; failure invalidates the batch (reported, not rerun)

auxiliary.items: reload ratio vs each competitor; cand/W9a for read_sum, mutate, emit_after, load, reload, total
auxiliary.rule: two-sided t(1-0.05/(2*10), df); report only, no gate

finality: single run; no resampling, deletion, trend removal or rerun; any child failure aborts the batch as failed; child timeout 30 s
